Description: Stock can never go negative — at product or lot level. A sale that exceeds available stock is rejected, not partially fulfilled.
Every product unit belongs to a lot with a lot number and an expiry date. No lot, no stock.
Expired lots cannot be sold. A lot is sellable only if `expiry_date > today` (store timezone).
Sales consume stock **FEFO** (first expired, first out) unless a pharmacist overrides it, and the override is audited.
Stock changes only through `stock_movements` entries. Movements are append-only: never updated or deleted; corrections are new compensating movements.
Manual adjustments and expiry write-offs require `pharmacist` or `admin` and a reason.
sanitary registration number is an optional field.
Products flagged `requires_prescription` can only be sold with a prescription reference attached to the sale line, should accept jpg, jpeg, png or pdf
Products flagged `controlled` additionally require: customer identification, prescriber data, a pharmacist's approval on the sale, and quantity no greater than what the prescription allows.
Products are deactivated, never hard-deleted, once they have movements or sales.
All money uses `NUMERIC(14,2)` in the DB and `Decimal` in Python — never floats. Rounding is half-up at line level, then totals are summed.
Checkout is atomic: sale, lines, lot decrements, stock movements and payments are written in one transaction, or nothing is written.
Sum of payments must equal the sale total (change is computed for cash, not stored as payment).
Prices and tax rates are copied onto each sale line at the moment of sale; later catalog changes never alter past sales.
Completed sales are immutable. Corrections are done with a return or void document that references the original sale and restocks via movements.
Voids are allowed only for the same register shift and require `pharmacist`/`admin`. Returns of Rx/controlled products require pharmacist approval.
Discounts above the configured cashier limit require `pharmacist`/`admin` authorization. A sale price can never be below cost unless an admin authorizes it.
Receipt/invoice numbers are sequential, gap-free per register, and never reused.
A cashier must open a register shift (opening cash) before selling and close it (counted cash vs. expected) at the end; the difference is recorded, not hidden.
Receipts must contain customer name and NIT/CUI
Card and transfers must contain a reference number, specific for cards the card type is required (visa, master card and amex are standards), for transfers the incoming bank name is required
For card payments store the last 4 digits
Every customer has a NIT/CUI; when the customer has none it is recorded as CF (consumidor final). CF is not a valid identification for controlled products (CAT-3).
Every create/update/delete on business data writes an audit log entry (who, when, what, before/after). Audit entries are append-only.
Role permissions are checked on the backend for every endpoint.
Customer and prescription data are personal/health data: only the roles that need them can read them, and they never appear in logs.
All timestamps are stored in UTC (`timestamptz`); business dates (expiry, shift date) use the store's configured timezone.
